name: CECEP Solar Energy Co.,Ltd.
summary: CECEP Solar Energy Co.,Ltd. provides solar power generation and power storage solutions in China, Europe, the Asia-Pacific, and internationally. It operates in three segments: Solar Power Generation, Solar Energy Products, and Others. The company invests, constructs, and operates photovoltaic power stations. It is also involved in the research, development, production, and sale of photovoltaic cells and modules. CECEP Solar Energy Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1993 and is based in Beijing, China.
